name: Jaden Manro
source: The protagonist of the story. Once cool, outgoing, reckless, yet smart, he became more secluded after his parents' death. He doesn't like being anyone except his best friend, Monica, for whom he lives with. Though he may show off a mean persona, he's actually a kind person who carries a huge burden...
